content.title: Three consecutive away matches
content.text: There are six matches remaining until the conclusion of the 2025/26 League, and Real Madrid will play the next three matches away from home. Betis, Espanyol, and Barcelona will be our team's opponents. This Friday, Arbeloa's side travels to Seville to face Betis on matchday 32 (9:00 pm CEST; Orange TV and Dazn). On Sunday, May 3, Madrid will visit Espanyol on matchday 34 (9:00 pm CEST; Orange TV and Movistar LaLiga). A week later, on Sunday, May 10, the Clásico arrives at Camp Nou, corresponding to matchday 35 (9:00 pm CEST; Orange TV and Movistar LaLiga). After these three consecutive away matches, the championship will conclude for our team with the matches at the Bernabéu against Oviedo and Athletic Club and the visit to Sevilla.
